layer.$description: The stacking order, as a z-index: the primitives, and the roles that read them. A role places a surface among what shares its stacking context.

below.$description: A surface drawn under its siblings, such as the block that slides under a list's rows.

raised.$description: A surface raised over the page, such as a popup.

top.$description: A surface over every raised one, such as the link that skips to the content.
